display_title: OOTD: He Might Not Be My Husband
description:
Before going off to war, Penelope's father marries her off to a man named Ulric so she can legally inherit his assets in the event of his death. Frustrated with this decision, Penelope doesn't even look at her husband's face at the altar, nor when he leaves for the battlefield along with her father. When Ulric comes home years later, he turns out to be a kind and caring husband, but he seems different from how he portrayed himself in his letters. Is he really the same man Penelope married? If not, who on earth could he be...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.*
